_comment: Prime's toolbox — the ONLY things the assistant can do to this computer. There is no shell tool. Each tool names the capability it needs (see ~/.config/prime/capabilities.yaml); prime-settings checks it, asks when needed, saves a desktop backup before any change, writes the audit log, and records how to undo. 'kind': read tools change nothing; write tools change something. 'external': the result contains text Prime didn't write (file or app names), so later changes in that turn always ask.

tools.name: get_status
tools.summary: look at your current desktop settings
tools.description: Current accent colour, wallpaper, look, settings, shortcuts Prime added, enabled packs, update policy and how much Prime may do on its own. Call this first when unsure.

tools.name: set_accent
tools.description: Change the accent colour used across the bar, menus, window borders and terminal. Use a colour name (red, orange, amber, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, silver, grey) or 6 hex digits like 60a5fa.

tools.name: list_wallpapers
tools.summary: list the wallpapers you can choose from
tools.description: Wallpapers available: Prime's own set plus pictures in ~/Pictures/Wallpapers.

tools.name: set_wallpaper
tools.description: Set the wallpaper. 'name' must be one of the names from list_wallpapers (e.g. prime-aurora.jpg).

tools.name: set_look
tools.description: Window spacing and corner style in one go. standard = Prime's default (soft corners, comfortable gaps); compact = small gaps, more room for content; sharp = square corners, almost no gaps; spacious = big gaps and very round corners.

tools.name: change_setting
tools.description: Change one common setting. animations: on|off. natural_scroll (touchpad and mouse scroll like a phone): on|off. keyboard_layout: an xkb layout code like us, gb, de, fr, es, or two separated by a comma (us,de). night_light (warmer colours to rest your eyes): off|on|a colour temperature 2500-6000. gaps (space between windows): 0-40. rounding (window corners): 0-30. mouse_speed: -1 (slowest) to 1 (fastest), 0 normal. mouse_acceleration: on|off. left_handed (swap mouse buttons): on|off. tap_to_click (touchpad): on|off. touchpad_while_typing: on|off (off pauses the touchpad while typing). key_repeat_rate: 10-80 per second. key_repeat_delay: 150-1000 ms. after_screenshot: buttons (show Edit, Ask Prime… on the notification) | save (just save and copy) | ask (always ask Prime about it). window_layout: free (new windows float and open centred, like a Mac or Windows) | tidy (windows tile side by side).

tools.name: list_shortcuts
tools.description: Every keyboard shortcut (Prime's defaults, add-ons, and the ones Prime added for the user). Use it to find a free key before adding one.

tools.name: add_shortcut
tools.description: Add or change a keyboard shortcut. keys: modifiers and one key joined with +, e.g. Super+B, Super+Shift+N, Ctrl+Alt+T, Super+F5. action: one of 'app' (open an installed app; target = its name or .desktop id, see list_apps), 'prime' (target = spotlight|menu|shortcuts|theme|screenshot|ask|lock|terminal|files|browser|health|tutor), 'window' (target = close|maximise|fullscreen|float|pin|minimise|workspace-1..10|next-window). Set replace=true only when the user agreed to replace an existing shortcut on those keys.

tools.name: remove_shortcut
tools.summary: remove the shortcut on {keys} that Prime added
tools.description: Remove a shortcut that Prime added earlier (Prime's built-in shortcuts can't be removed, only replaced with add_shortcut replace=true).

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: Installed apps. kind = browser | file_manager | text_editor | any.

tools.name: set_default_app
tools.description: Choose which installed app opens web links, folders or text files. app = a name or .desktop id from list_apps.

tools.name: list_packs
tools.description: Packs and add-ons (gaming, coding, creator, student, ai…) with a description and whether each is on.

tools.name: enable_pack
tools.description: Switch on a pack or add-on by name (from list_packs). Packs that install apps ask for the user's password in a window.

tools.name: disable_pack
tools.summary: turn off the {name} pack (its apps stay installed)
tools.description: Switch off a pack or add-on. Its apps and files stay; only its shortcuts, menu rows and bar items go.

tools.name: run_doctor
tools.summary: check the desktop and repair what it safely can
tools.description: Run the desktop health check (Super+H). It restarts stuck bar/clipboard services and regenerates theme files; it never edits the user's own files.

tools.name: start_update
tools.summary: update the whole system now (opens a window; asks for your password)
tools.description: Update Prime Linux, system packages and App Store apps, in a window the user can watch. A system snapshot and a desktop backup are taken first.

tools.name: set_update_policy
tools.description: How updates happen: automatic (recommended: nightly, snapshot first, never reboots on its own), ask (tell me, I'll choose when), off.

tools.name: list_backups
tools.summary: list saved copies of your desktop settings
tools.description: Saved copies of the desktop settings (newest first), made before every update and every change Prime makes.

tools.name: save_desktop
tools.summary: save a copy of your desktop settings
tools.description: Save a copy of the desktop settings now (bar, menus, windows, theme, Prime).

label.description: a short word for the copy, e.g. before-experiment

tools.name: restore_desktop
tools.summary: put your desktop settings back to the copy from {when}
tools.description: Restore a saved copy of the desktop settings (from list_backups, or 'latest'). Everything changed since then in those settings is replaced — a copy of the current state is saved first.

tools.name: undo_last
tools.description: Undo the most recent change Prime made (accent, wallpaper, setting, shortcut, pack…).

tools.name: show_shortcuts
tools.description: Open the searchable keyboard-shortcut sheet (Super+/) on screen, for teaching.
